description: Pre-registered, seeded, reproducible draw. For each outlet, take every collected article URL whose date (RSS pubDate or Atom published, else a date in the URL, else sitemap lastmod) falls in the inclusive window, after the outlet path filters in data/collectors.json and after dropping known paywall_exclusions. Sort the week (ISO week in Africa/Johannesburg) by (published_at, url). Using random.Random(seed) and iterating outlets then weeks in sorted order, draw k=2 without replacement from each outlet-week stratum (or all of the stratum if it has fewer than 2). The seed and this algorithm are frozen for v1; a later window or k is a new algorithm_id, not an edit of this file's seed. If a drawn URL is later found to be paywalled, 404, or non-article at fetch, replace it with the next unused URL from the same stratum in the original sort order (no new random draw). A coded-and-clean article with no driver still counts in the sample denominator and does not get a finding row.
paywall_rule: Known rows in data/paywall_exclusions.csv and data/paywall_register.csv are excluded from the candidate pool before the draw. No paywalled body is fetched, spoofed, or scored.
tls_rule: Collectors never disable TLS verification. Certificate and TLS errors are logged and the run continues.
prior_procedure_note: The earlier News24 May–Oct 2026 skew-fix pass used mid-week politics date proxies, not this RNG. Those existing rows keep their sample_frame tags. New coding under this rule uses algorithm_id neutral_random_v1.
private_names_rule: If tests/private_names.local.txt is present, any candidate whose URL or title contains a denylist term (case-insensitive) is dropped before the draw, the same way known-paywall URLs are dropped. The denylist file is gitignored and is never committed. The committed candidate and draw lists must already have this filter applied.
